basic_info.description: Soma Grand residence 2007 is a spacious 2 bedroom/2 bath with dark bamboo flooring in the main areas and luxury carpet in the bedrooms, original Studio Becker cabinets, Bosch range, quartz counter tops and in-unit front loading washer/dryer.  The primary suite features a spacious bathroom with double vanity and a walk-in closet.  The 2nd bedroom has views forever from the giant corner windows - perfect for work from home or even as a 2nd living room if it is not needed as sleeping quarters.  The building's amenties, which include BBQ area, firepit, hot tub, workout room and concierge services are legendary.  In addition, there is no more convenient place to live in San Francisco.  Take a quick walk to Trader Joe's or San Francisco's unique Rainbow Grocery.  With mere steps to the SF Public Library, The Asian Art Museum, The SF Ballet, Davies Symphony Hall, the Yerba Buena Center, SF MOMA and so much more, this location is truly the cultural center of the City.  Nightlife of all kinds including music (think Slim's) and some of the best Drag (Oasis and AsiaSF!) in the world are also nearby, as is transportation for when you want to go somewhere else.  BART, tech shuttles and 80/101/280 freeway access are all close and there is 1 car parking available for lease in the garage.
